children: Bio-Techne supplemented its proxy statement and disclosed litigation and demand letters tied to the Merck KGaA acquisition while preserving the Sept. 23 shareholder vote.
Filed definitive proxy for special meeting on Sept. 23, 2026 to vote on Merck KGaA's proposed merger.

Voluntarily supplemented proxy disclosures to avoid delays, nuisance and potential vote injunction risks.
